summary: Tested Gamification/User Levels System. All 18 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed for both Admin (Platino) and Bronce user levels. Level calculation, progress bars, dynamic messages, and level badges all working correctly.
passed_tests: ✅ GET /api/user/level - Returns level data with all required fields (level, label, icon, benefits, progress, next, message, leveled_up)
✅ Level calculation: Admin with €74,485+ balance = Platino level
✅ Level calculation: Test user with €0 balance = Bronce level
✅ Platino user shows 'Nivel maximo alcanzado' (no next level, next=null)
✅ Bronce user shows progress to Plata with 0% progress
✅ Bronce user shows 'Te faltan €2500 para alcanzar Plata' message
✅ Dynamic message: 'Completa tu proceso para mejorar tus beneficios' for low progress (<20%)
✅ Investment balance (savings account EUR) included in total_balance_eur
✅ Login count (30d) included in level data
✅ leveled_up field exists for level-up detection
✅ Level order field exists for comparison
✅ Next level benefits included for non-max levels
✅ API requires authentication (401 without token)
✅ Invalid token rejected (401)
✅ Dashboard: UserLevelCard displays correctly for Platino (cyan/purple gradient)
✅ Dashboard: UserLevelCard displays correctly for Bronce (amber/gold theme)
✅ Dashboard: Progress bar shows 0% for Bronce user
✅ Dashboard: Benefits displayed correctly for both levels
✅ Sidebar: LevelBadge shows '🥉 Bronce' for non-admin users
✅ Sidebar: LevelBadge correctly NOT shown for admin users
✅ Platino benefits: 'Maxima prioridad', 'Acceso anticipado a nuevas funciones', 'Soporte dedicado', 'Beneficios exclusivos'
✅ Bronce benefits: 'Acceso basico a la plataforma', 'Tiempo de procesamiento estandar'
seed_data_creation: Created test.bronce@test.com user with €0 balance for Bronce level testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gamification system fully tested. 4 levels: Bronce (default), Plata (€2,500 or 5+ logins), Oro (€10,000 or 15+ logins), Platino (€25,000 or active investment). Admin account is Platino level (~€74,485 balance). Test user test.bronce@test.com is Bronce level (€0 balance). UserLevelCard component shows level, benefits, progress bar, and dynamic messages. LevelBadge shows in sidebar for non-admin users only. Level-up popup triggers when leveled_up=true (first time level increases).

ui_components.LevelBadge: Sidebar badge showing level icon + name (non-admin only)
